about: The translator tool's own files: what the app packs (package.json extraResources), what bundled.json describes, and what a release of the app's repository publishes for its updates (web-dev/tools/translator_manifest.py, updater.js). shell: raise it, and main.js TOOL_SHELL with it, when the tool comes to need something of the app around it that older apps lack (a new Python module, a change to main.js); older apps are then sent to download the app again instead of taking the update.
